positioning.statement: Teknologi intim lelaki yang discreet, boleh guna semula, direka di Malaysia. Dr. MIT Ring® brings Male Intimacy Technology (M.I.T.) to couples with clinical authority, discretion, and Malaysian design.

pillars.title: Male Intimacy Technology
pillars.text: Precision engineered ergonomic ring (M.I.T.), designed for comfortable intimacy and confidence.

pillars.title: Clinical authority & discretion
pillars.text: Positioned with clinical authority under SS Clinic medical oversight, presented with total discretion.

pillars.title: Direka oleh SuamiSihat
pillars.text: Proudly signed off with 'Direka oleh SuamiSihat'. Engineered locally for Malaysian men.

voice: Calm and clean, clinical and confident, never crude
Instructional: short steps, clear care advice
Bahasa Malaysia first; respectful of both partners
avoid: Unapproved claims: erection, hardness, stamina, 'tahan lama', or ejaculation wording NOT matching the MDA-registered intended use
Doctor endorsement without written consent on file (Dr Amir consentRef pending)
Vulgar or suggestive slang: 'pancut / muntah' wording
Retired lineage references or unverified patent / medical claims

foundation.role: Canvas and lime field (web: off-white canvas; pack: lime field)

structure.role: Neutral Black for text, wordmark pill and illustration

colors.name: Deep Green
colors.use: Pack shapes, large text only (PANTONE 355 C)

accent.role: Light lime tints and one yellow count chip

colors.name: Yellow
colors.use: Count chip on black only (PANTONE 102 C)

pairings.use: Buttons and text on Deep Green AA
White headings on Deep Green, large text only

forbidden.use: White text on Lime is 2.45:1 (fails WCAG AA min 4.5:1). Never use white text on lime.
Yellow count sticker on Lime is 1.93:1. Yellow highlights belong on black only.

colorScheme.note: Never white on lime (2.45:1) or yellow on lime (1.93:1). The premium update moves the box to matte off-white or black with lime as the signal colour only. Tokens: static/assets/tokens/product-brands.tokens.json.

pattern.name: Ring Ripple
pattern.description: Offset concentric rings in Lime and Deep Green with a soft black halo on Dr Mit Green, abstracted from the ring's shape.
usage: Use as a background on green panels, banners and box sides
Keep text on a solid green or black panel, not directly on the rings
Do not rotate, recolour or crop the rings into the logo badge
One pattern area per layout, at most a third of the surface

logos.label: Dr. MIT Ring wordmark pill
logos.use: White outline pill and letters on black; on lime, always on a filled black pill

guideline.clearSpace: Keep half the pill height clear on every side.
do: Place the pill on black, or as a filled black pill on lime
Set 'MALE INTIMACY TECHNOLOGY' (or 'M.I.T.') above the pill on packs and listings
Sign off 'Dr. MIT Ring® · Direka oleh SuamiSihat'
dont: Do not place the transparent pill directly on lime or white
Do not publish doctor name or photo without written consent on file
Do not retype, recolour or stretch the wordmark
Do not use sexual-function claims outside the MDA-registered intended use

typography.display: Poppins ExtraBold / Black headlines; Poppins SemiBold caps, tracked +240, for the descriptor
typography.note: The brush-script ad font is retired. Never retype the wordmark.

guideline.photography: Product-only: packs and ring on clean off-white or textured neutral surfaces. No anatomy, no explicit or suggestive imagery.
